Pace used in this example

  • 2–4 completed outside courses per month is a planning assumption, not a provider promise.
  • 12–24 competency units per university 6-month term is a planning assumption.
  • Outside providers are studied one after another in this scenario; overlapping study can change the elapsed time.
  • University loads use unit totals. Prerequisites, whole-course scheduling, start dates, breaks and registration availability can add time.
  • One-time university fees are included once; subtract charges you have already paid.

What this range leaves out

  • Saylor retakes cost $5 per attempt (up to 3 attempts, 14 days apart, 70% to pass) and are not included. A few Saylor courses use a free built-in proctor, so the real exam cost can be lower.
  • Application fee waivers, optional supplies and any additional program or testing charges are not assumed.
  • Applicable sales tax on course subscriptions.
  • Books, supplies, course-specific charges and transcript charges when applicable.
  • Housing, meals, travel, health insurance and other living costs.
  • Rates are before financial aid, military benefits, scholarships, discounts and future price changes.
  • Completed or reported courses are excluded from new course charges; school acceptance of reported credit remains separate.
  • This is a range of known tuition, required university fees and selected outside-course charges, not a complete cost of attendance or a graduation-date promise.
  • Study.com uses the full College Saver Pro library price; an eligible lower-priced membership may reduce your cost.
  • Sophia uses the lowest published mix of monthly, four-month and annual memberships for the assumed study time. Prepaid plans require the upfront payment; promotions and tax are excluded.

Questions

Does Saylor Introduction to Critical Thinking and Logic transfer to Western Governors University?

Yes, for this degree. WGU’s published transfer guidance lists Saylor Introduction to Critical Thinking and Logic for D265 Critical Thinking: Reason and Evidence (3 competency units) in the Project Management – B.S..

Does Study.com English 104: College Composition I transfer to Western Governors University?

Yes, for this degree. WGU’s published transfer guidance lists Study.com English 104: College Composition I for D270 Composition: Successful Self-Expression (3 competency units) in the Project Management – B.S..

Does Saylor Business Statistics transfer to Western Governors University?

Yes, for this degree. WGU’s published transfer guidance lists Saylor Business Statistics for C955 Applied Probability and Statistics (3 competency units) in the Project Management – B.S..

How many credits can I transfer into Western Governors University’s Project Management – B.S.?

WGU’s published limit for this 120-unit degree is 90 competency units from other sources. This plan proposes 60 competency units through outside courses.

Which courses must I take at Western Governors University?

In this plan, 60 competency units are taken at WGU, including D640 Giving, Receiving and Incorporating Feedback, C721 Change Management, D641 Adapting to Ambiguity, D642 Empathy and Inclusive Collaboration, D253 Values-Based Leadership and E101 Applied Professional Experience and 4 more.

How much does this plan cost?

The planning estimate is $12,643 to $21,037 before aid. It covers tuition, listed fees and the outside courses in this plan. It is not a complete cost of attendance.

Has Western Governors University confirmed this plan?

This plan uses WGU’s published degree requirements and transfer guidance. Admission and your own transcript evaluation are still WGU’s decisions.
